criterion_descriptions.bounded_processing_memory: processing and memory stay within deterministic bounds
criterion_descriptions.checkpoint_consistency: checkpoints are consistent with the journal
criterion_descriptions.conflicting_duplicate_detection: same-time different-bar events are rejected and alerted one-for-one
criterion_descriptions.duplicate_suppression: exact duplicates are suppressed on every instrument
criterion_descriptions.event_acceptance_correctness: each accepted stream is strictly monotonic and unique; every rejection maps to its injected fault; every fault flag fires; the accepted floor is met
criterion_descriptions.journal_durability: the append-only journal is durable and hash-chained
criterion_descriptions.kill_switch_trip_latency: the kill switch trips within its drilled latency bound
criterion_descriptions.qualification_coverage: the run has at least one instrument and every instrument is covered by a resource report and a recovery report (no vacuous pass)
criterion_descriptions.state_reconstruction: journal and checkpoint reconstruct the state exactly
criterion_descriptions.zero_risky_exposure: every fill and intent is exactly zero exposure/notional/turnover; the book stays 100% cash; no exposure-driven kill trip

pass_rule: a criterion passes only if it holds for every instrument; the verdict passes only if every criterion passes
